prompts.final: "Create a hyper-detailed luxury real estate visualization showcasing CMF Inmobiliaria's premium skyline residences at golden hour. Frame a 45-degree wide-angle shot of floor-to-ceiling windows revealing a glowing metropolitan panorama, captured in 8K HDR with crisp bokeh highlighting champagne flutes on a quartz terrace table. Compose a triptych: Left panel features a 30s entrepreneur in tailored suit using smart home tablets to adjust ambient lighting (warm gold accents illuminating open-concept living space with curated art pieces), center vertical slice reveals before/after transformation from empty unit to furnished masterpiece with parametric architecture elements, right panel displays 5-star amenities through glass partitions - infinity-edge indoor pool with submerged LED lighting merging with city lights below. Employ dramatic diagonal composition using building's structural lines to guide eye toward rooftop lounge's firepit social scene (diverse professionals 35-55 laughing under designer pendant lights). Insert subtle urgency elements: holographic ROI projection (12% graph fading into skyline) and translucent 'Last Units' callout integrated into window reflection. Use metallic duotone grading (platinum + amber) with calculated negative space for text overlay zones. Render materials with hyperreal precision: veined marble spa walls, brushed brass smart home interfaces, and kinetic sculpture installations in lobby. Include strategic aerial insert showing proximity to glowing business district towers connected by light trails. Technical specs: f/2.8 aperture for foreground lifestyle vignettes transitioning to f/16 for razor-sharp architectural details, mixed ambient/cinematic lighting ratios (3:1 key/fill), ISO-mapped texture enhancement on luxury finishes. Visual hierarchy prioritizes 1) Panoramic view 2) Smart home demonstration 3) ROI data visualization 4) Social proof elements, all unified through CMF's signature navy-and-gold brand spectrum."

prompts.final:
**Enhanced Prompt:**  
"Professional portrait of two individuals (aged 30-55) in a sleek, minimalist workspace with a focus on modern efficiency. Both subjects exude a dynamic, achievement-oriented energy, dressed in tailored business-casual attire (neutral tones with subtle pops of navy or charcoal for sophistication). Lighting: Soft, diffused natural light from floor-to-ceiling windows blends with warm ambient LEDs, creating a crisp, clean atmosphere with gentle shadows for depth. Camera setup: Medium close-up (24-70mm lens at 50mm) with a shallow depth of field (f/2.8) to highlight sharp facial details while softly blurring the tech-forward environment.  

First subject interacts organically with a premium productivity device (e.g., slim laptop or holographic planner), fingers lightly tapping the interface—captured mid-motion for authenticity. Second subject stands slightly angled, holding a modular smart organizer, gaze focused upward with a composed, aspirational expression (subtle smile, engaged eyes). Composition uses rule-of-thirds framing to balance their interaction, with negative space emphasizing modernity.  

Mood: Elevated professionalism meets approachable ambition. Color palette: Muted taupe and ivory backgrounds contrast with metallic accents (brushed gold, matte black tech) and a strategic pop of emerald green (symbolizing growth). Textures: Smooth matte surfaces, crisp fabric folds, and glossy device screens for visual interest.  

FLUX-specific enhancements: Hyper-detailed skin textures (micro wrinkles, natural skin gradients), 8K-rendered accessories (watch faces, fabric weaves), and dynamic global illumination to unify lighting across both subjects. Subtle rim lighting separates figures from the backdrop, adding dimensionality. Ensure consistent shadow softness (diffuser grid technique) and zero noise for a polished, high-end finish. Focus on micro-expressions—hints of determination in furrowed brows, relaxed jawlines conveying confidence."
